children: Binance Wallet announced on X that Binance Alpha 2.0 will support the TAC (TAC) contract swap on BNB Smart Chain (BEP20). Trading for TAC will be temporarily suspended starting from 2026-09-04 at 02:00 UTC to facilitate the swap. The contract swap will be carried out at a 1:1 ratio, and Binance Alpha 2.0 trading of TAC is expected to resume on 2026-09-04 at 08:00 UTC. The notice did not provide additional details beyond the suspension period, swap ratio, and expected resumption time.

title: Binance Alpha 2.0 to Support TAC Contract Swap on BNB Smart Chain
